lines.l: Typical, but I can love you when I know it's not enough
Not enough, enough, enough, enough, enough, enough
I saw you hanging by the club again
You all had dressed and made you stand out from your friends
I took a moment to hesitate
You had me feeling more than I could comprehend
I wanna tell you you're beautiful
These guys are nothing when they're next to you
Oh girl, I know that this sounds so typical
But I can love you when I know it's not enough
And enough, and enough, and enough
Oh, no, no, no, no, no
